aws: Terraform: the provider these resources come from
aws_dynamodb_table: Terraform AWS provider: resource type, a DynamoDB table
aws_s3_bucket: Terraform AWS provider: resource type, an S3 bucket
aws_sqs_queue: Terraform AWS provider: resource type, an SQS queue
aws_sns_topic: Terraform AWS provider: resource type, an SNS topic
aws_cloudwatch_event_bus: Terraform AWS provider: resource type, an EventBridge bus
aws_elasticache_cluster: Terraform AWS provider: resource type, an ElastiCache cluster
aws_elasticache_replication_group: Terraform AWS provider: resource type, an ElastiCache replication group
engine: Terraform AWS provider: the attribute stating which cache engine a cluster runs
redis: ElastiCache engine name, and the store suss records for it
valkey: ElastiCache engine name, a fork that speaks the Redis protocol
store: suss: a resource that says a store exists without stating its containers
read: suss: what an unset gate attribute means when the entry says to read it anyway
hash_key: Terraform AWS provider: the attribute a table partitions by
range_key: Terraform AWS provider: the attribute a table sorts by
global_secondary_index: Terraform AWS provider: a block declaring an index that keys differently from the table
local_secondary_index: Terraform AWS provider: a block declaring an index that shares the table's partition key
attribute: Terraform AWS provider: a block giving a key attribute its type
name: Terraform AWS provider: the attribute stating what a resource is called once deployed
type: Terraform AWS provider: the attribute stating a key attribute's type
bucket: Terraform AWS provider: the attribute stating what a bucket is called
storage: suss: boundary kind for a store
partial: suss: a storage contract that declares some of an item's fields
none: suss: a storage contract with no fields to compare against
projection_type: Terraform AWS provider: the attribute stating which copy of an item an index keeps
non_key_attributes: Terraform AWS provider: the attribute listing what an INCLUDE index copies
ALL: Terraform AWS provider: the projection type of an index that copies the whole item
